title: SELF-DEVELOPMENT
mv: A wise man will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel.
mvp: “A wise man will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel.” Proverbs 1:5 (NKJV)
assignment: Write down five (5) things you are doing or want to do to develop yourself in any field of life (2X5=10 marks).

b.x: Every great destiny is achieved through intentional effort. Development does not come cheap and is not automatic. Youths carry enormous potentials, but potential becomes meaningful only when it is nurtured. Self-development is the commitment to grow spiritually, mentally, emotionally, and skilfully so you can fulfil God’s purpose for your life.

Self-development could be for professional advancement, spiritual enhancement or personal progression (Daniel 9:2). Whatever your goals may be, it is a continuous process that helps you bring in significant changes in your life. The reasons you should develop yourself include:

i: It Honours God’s Investment in You. God has placed gifts, abilities, and purpose inside you. Developing yourself is a way of multiplying what God has entrusted to you (Matthew 25:14-29). When you grow, you reflect God’s excellence.

Your Generation Needs a Prepared You. Opportunities favour those who are equipped. Excellence does not appear suddenly; it is the fruit of continuous growth. Your preparation determines your influence (Proverbs 22:29).

It Builds Confidence and Resilience. Self-development strengthens your identity and equips you to face challenges (Proverbs 3:25-26). When you invest in skills and spiritual maturity, you reduce fear and become more adaptable in a fast-changing world (Philippians 1:6).

It Shapes Your Future: The habits you cultivate today create the person you become tomorrow. Consistent growth ensures you do not waste your youthful years but turn them into a foundation for a meaningful and impactful adulthood (Galatians 6:9).
Grow Spiritually: Make prayer, Bible study, worship, and obedience to God’s word your lifestyle. Nothing strengthens personal development more than spiritual depth (1 Timothy 4:13-15).
Deliberately Pursue Knowledge: Read books, take online courses, listen to teachings, and ask questions (Proverbs 1:5; Ecclesiastes 1:13). Avoid mental laziness; aim to learn something new every day.

Develop Relevant Skills: Identify skills that empower your purpose e.g. communication, leadership, creativity, digital skills, financial discipline, teamwork, and problem-solving. Practice consistently until improvement becomes visible (1 Timothy 4:15).

Build Healthy Relationships: Surround yourself with mentors, accountable peers, and high achievers (Proverbs 27:17; 1 Samuel 22:1-2). Wrong company destroys potential, but the right company accelerates it (Proverbs 13:20).

Set Goals and Take Action: Growth is intentional. Set realistic and time-bound goals. Track your progress and celebrate improvements. A future you desire must be supported by habits you practice (1 Timothy 4:16).
Seek Feedback and Stay Humble: Be open to correction. Feedback exposes blind spots and helps you refine your character and competence (Proverbs 10:17).

b.x: God has designed you for greatness, but growth is a partnership between His grace and your discipline. Start early, stay consistent, and your life will shine as a testimony of God’s work in you.

i: Mention four reasons you should develop yourself.
